T004 : ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (GP.Space n)),
  ((∀ (m : ℕ) (A : Set (GP.Space m)),
        0 ≤ dimH A ∧
          ∀ (s : ℝ),
            0 < s →
              GP.hausdorff s A = (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure s) A ∧
                (dimH A < ENNReal.ofReal s → GP.hausdorff s A = 0) ∧
                  (ENNReal.ofReal s < dimH A → GP.hausdorff s A = ∞) ∧
                    (GP.hausdorff s A = 0 → dimH A ≤ ENNReal.ofReal s) ∧
                      (GP.hausdorff s A = ∞ → ENNReal.ofReal s ≤ dimH A)) ∧
      ∀ (A : Set ℝ) (s : ℝ), 0 < s → GP.hausdorff s A = (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure s) A) →
    (dimH E < ∞ ∧
        0 ≤ dimH E ∧
          dimH E ≤ ↑n ∧
            (n = 0 → E = Set.univ ∧ (∃ x, E = {x}) ∧ dimH E = 0) ∧ ∀ (s δ : ℝ), 0 < s → 0 < δ → GP.content s δ E < ∞) →
      (dimH GP.unitInterval = 1 ∧
          (∀ (a : ℝ), 1 < a → GP.hausdorff a GP.unitInterval = 0) ∧
            ∀ (s : ℝ), 0 < s → s < 1 → GP.hausdorff s GP.unitInterval = ∞) →
        n = 0 → dimH (GP.cylinder E) ≤ dimH E + 1
'Translation.T004' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
